clips.text: Dom voice on.
The Grand Last Resort! Five stars. Four are still pending.
The undead? Repeat customers. Exceptional retention.
That is not a horde. It is an extremely motivated viewing party.
The sea view is included. A sea rescue costs extra.
The asking price is negotiable. The zombies are less flexible.
I said open-plan potential. The chef took that personally.
That boarded door? Bespoke timber. Very boutique.
Breakfast is continental. Survival is supplementary.
Free late checkout! Early checkout is now strongly recommended.
A little lively in the bar, but the spirits are excellent.
No chain! Unless you count whatever is holding the boiler together.
Excellent footfall. Regrettable bitefall.
Offers over one bag of biscuits. I know what I have.
A guest has turned!
The bride has turned!
Saved in the nick of time!
The guest has been rescued. Keep moving!
The chef has left the kitchen. Head chef checked out.
Two zombies checked out!
Three zombies checked out!
Quad checkout!
Housekeeping!
A barricade gave way! They are out!
Guest saved. Safely aboard the coach.
Foamed! Keep moving!
Fire extinguisher. Foams crowds.
Tea and biscuits. Health restored.
Room sealed. Zombies locked in.
Midnight. The bars have emptied.
One o'clock. Runners! Some of them can sprint.
Three o'clock. The kitchen stirs. Something wants service.
Five o'clock. Last call! One hour to the coach.
Another guest has turned!
We've got another turned guest!
Ah! Get off me, you daft sod!
Bloody hell! I'm not on the menu!
Pack it in! That's me good arm, you pillock!
Get off me backside! Buy me a pint first!
Oi! Bite the brochure, you rotten barmpot!
Ah! Personal space, you gormless great lump!
Bloody hell! I'm leaking worse than the boiler!
I'm not done yet, you miserable sod!
Ah! Tell Monty... I want me wages!
Oh, bugger! I'm clocking off!
